controls.title: DRIVER INPUT
controls.full: Hold W / ↑ to accelerate; S / ↓ brakes. A / D or ← / → steer. Click and drag left or right across the track to steer; release to recenter. Space jumps; hold F to drift; hold Shift to boost while throttling; Esc pauses.
controls.mobile: Touch: drag the virtual wheel up to accelerate, down to brake and left / right to steer; hold BOOST / DRIFT, tap JUMP. Controller: left stick or D-pad drives; A jumps; LB drifts; RT boosts while throttling.
controls.prompt.keyboard: HOLD W / ↑ THROTTLE · A / D STEER · S / ↓ BRAKE · F DRIFT · SHIFT BOOST
controls.prompt.pointer: CLICK + DRAG TO STEER · RELEASE TO CENTER · W / ↑ THROTTLE · S / ↓ BRAKE
controls.prompt.pad: LEFT STICK / D-PAD DRIVE · A JUMP · LB DRIFT · RT BOOST · START PAUSE
controls.prompt.touch: DRAG WHEEL: UP GAS · DOWN BRAKE · LEFT / RIGHT STEER · HOLD BOOST / DRIFT
